strengths: Clear and well-scoped problem statement: context overflow and looping failures in CLI agents are genuine pain points with practical consequences (timeouts, degraded performance).
Training-free deployment is a meaningful practical advantage; the system requires no fine-tuning and is backend-agnostic.
Concrete, quantified results (+21.2pp completion rate, elimination of all timeout failures) make the empirical claims easy to evaluate.
The distinction between DCC (deterministic extraction) and PLC (loop shaping vs. termination) is principled and the motivation for each module is clearly articulated.
weaknesses: The third contribution bullet partially undercuts the system: admitting PLC has a 0.12% block rate and is a 'conservative safety net' raises the question of whether it belongs in the system at all, and why it is presented as a co-equal contribution.
Single-dataset, single-model evaluation (Terminal-Bench 2.0, Qwen3-32B) is a significant limitation; generalizability across other CLI benchmarks and LLM backends is undemonstrated.

The introduction conflates two metrics without reconciling them: 68.8% is reported as the LASCon headline, but 70.0% is attributed to DCC alone, implying PLC slightly hurts performance — this tension is not explained.
Related work on context compression, memory management, and agent scaffolding is only superficially covered; no comparison to retrieval-augmented or structured memory approaches.
The scope of 'exact tokens critical for task completion' as the motivation for DCC over LLM summarization is asserted but not empirically validated in isolation.

ai_detection.reasoning: The introduction follows a textbook AI-paper template with near-perfect fidelity: one-paragraph problem, one-paragraph prior-work critique, one-paragraph method, then a three-bullet 'Our contributions are:' list. Prose is uniformly dense and impersonal with no hedging, narrative variation, or authorial voice. The bullet structure, formulaic transition phrases ('two complementary modules', 'training-free scaffold intervention'), and the absence of any discursive detour are strong AI-generation signals.
